purpose: Extend existing Appendix P audit to every surface, geometry, certificate, order, tolerance and budget without new simulation.
independent_unit: world=(surface,scenario,replicate); 1800 total, 600 per geometry, 200 per surface/geometry

bootstrap.interval: individual exploratory 95% percentile; no simultaneous superiority inference; all caps retain descriptive metrics

rules: Do not mix carried stopped outcomes and complete-prefix outcomes
Complete-prefix width is certificate width; refusal output width is unavailable from plans
Complete-prefix path coverage means all certificate intervals through the prefix, not stopped returned-output coverage
Weight fitting is design-only; inverse variance uses known DGP noise
Order, optimized weights and certificate type are distinct factors
No adaptive R2, logdet, external-method superiority or real calibration claim

forecast.basis: Prior exact 345600-record and 172800-plan audit took 4.14 seconds; extended bootstrap arithmetic adds matrices of 2000 paired world resamples

review_status_policy: Record all twelve before/after; preserve original status; no resolved status.
